summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of Prothous son of Tenthredon in the Iliad catalogue and of other Prothous figures in Greek myth.

story.text: Apollodorus names Prothous among the wooers assigned to Same, listed after Clytius and before Lycaethus in Epitome 7.28.

Homer's catalogue of ships knows Prothous son of Tenthredon as leader of the Magnetes; Apollodorus elsewhere names Prothous among sons of Agrius and among sons of Thestius — none of whom is this Cephallenian wooer.
